scope: Executed existing pure-rule suites against the current full runtime; third-batch rules are separate.

checks.name: Leap years and calendar date validity
Date arithmetic crosses leap day and year without timestamp conversion
Week, month and trailing range presets are exact inclusive calendar dates
CSV BOM, quoted comma, escaped quote and embedded newline
TSV pasted from spreadsheet preserves leading zero IDs
Roster rejects missing fields, duplicate and previously imported IDs
Roster input limits and malformed quotes reject explicitly
Custom table records and columns render without course-only dependencies
Table duplicate IDs and missing column keys reject
User-configured text is escaped in date, resource, organization and table
Workspace remains an empty business slot without default publishing or editor
All current catalog components and page patterns render
ISO week-year boundary and 53-week validation
Period validity and leap-year datetime validation
Periods cover whole month, quarter and ISO week
Forbidden dates invalidate entire range and calendar periods
Reversed, partial and out-of-bounds values do not become committed state
Multi-date deduplicates, sorts and excludes forbidden values
Local datetimes retain wall-clock values without timezone conversion
Scalar zero is retained in input, statistics and badges
New renderers escape labels, values, descriptions and content
Unsafe image and navigation schemes are rejected
Schema rejects invalid names, duplicates, unknown types and invalid sections
Empty schema stays empty and caller-owned configuration is not mutated
Defaults retain zero, false, empty arrays and repeater values
Conditional visibility and dependent options respect actual data
Synchronous rules preserve numeric zero and enforce range, step and required
Email, URL, regex and cross-field dates fail meaningfully
Richtext validation counts plain text and recognizes empty markup
Table validates nested identity and rejects incompatible variable-height virtual modes
Nested headers flatten only leaves, and sort handles nulls and numeric text
Table config never mutates the caller rows or columns
Public renderers escape schema/table labels and editable richtext source
Calendar rejects impossible Gregorian dates without throwing for invalid months
Nested identities reject duplicates across separate branches
Family renderers escape caller text and content instead of running HTML
Executable, protocol-relative and HTML image addresses are denied
Configurable AI/business renderers retain supplied objects without fixed-course substitution
Family rendering does not mutate nested input records or initial tab state
All six families and all caller configurations render without mutation
Nested IDs are stable, unique, safe and reject duplicate branches
Audience records must refer to actual class nodes and scope modes are explicit
Curriculum aggregates leaf hours and rejects duplicate parent allocation
Curriculum totals, mode, positive hours and fractional steps are business constraints
Task dependency cycles, unsupported states and invalid dates are rejected
Five question types preserve false and detect incomplete fill or invalid options
Student configuration does not serialize unreleased reference answers or grading feedback
Weighted and point rubrics distinguish zero, unscored and excluded dimensions
Rubric totals, level values and incoming values cannot silently pass invalid configuration
Submission history validates unique versions and consistent rubric maximum
All domain labels, bodies and authored text are escaped
All seven empty components and 28 independent configurations render without mutating caller data
Duplicate person numbers and duplicate IDs are rejected
Student grade configuration excludes others and all unannounced grade history
Published zero values are preserved for the current student
Assignments reject duplicate active teaching relationship and primary conflict
Assignment terms, inactive teachers, and class scope are checked before saving
Practice dependency cycles and unknown material references are rejected
Learning dependency cycles, duplicate resources, invalid record positions are rejected
Resource version numbers are immutable unique positive integers and links are safe
Student resource configuration removes drafts, unavailable and expired contents
Text version comparisons reflect actual changed and added lines
Survey answer validation preserves false and zero ratings and enforces required responses
Survey maximum choices and unknown choice IDs are rejected
Survey raw responses are stripped for students and aggregate values survive repeated sanitization
Unreleased survey aggregates remain unavailable and empty means remain null
Grades distinguish null, zero, absence, and explicitly exempt values
Point grades renormalize allowed exemptions and reject invalid total weights
Unsupported roles, invalid time windows and unsafe identifiers fail explicitly
All authored labels and bodies are escaped before insertion into HTML
